description: Presolve a weighted set-cover incidence matrix using the chapter's row, simple column, and advanced column domination rules.

source.title: Set Cover with Almost Consecutive Ones
source.algorithm_attribution: Row domination, column domination, and advanced column domination reductions; profile-specific deterministic scan order and equal-cost ties.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded presolve profile; does not implement the chapter's set-cover solver

input.row_mask_rule: Bit j is 1 iff original column j covers the row.

output.identity_rule: Row and column IDs are zero-based original indices in ascending order. Each reduced row mask uses compact bit positions matching the ascending retained column_ids array.
output.success_result: 8 times the number of output words

contract.row_dominance: If the active-column option set of row i is a subset of row j's option set, remove row j; for equal sets retain the lower original row ID.
contract.simple_column_dominance: Remove active column c1 when its active-row coverage is a subset of c2's and weight(c1)>=weight(c2); for equal coverages and weights retain the lower original column ID.
contract.advanced_column_dominance: For distinct active c1,c2 with nonempty coverage intersection, let X contain the unique minimum-weight active column covering each row in coverage(c1)\coverage(c2), breaking minimum-weight ties by lower original column ID. Remove c1 when weight(c1)>=weight(c2)+sum(weight(x) for x in X).
contract.scan_and_restart: Repeat to a fixed point. Scan row keep/drop pairs in ascending original IDs and apply the first eligible row reduction. If none applies, scan simple column drop/keep pairs in ascending IDs. If none applies, scan advanced column drop/keep pairs in ascending IDs. After any single deletion, restart from the row rule.
contract.preservation: The exact minimum weighted set-cover cost is preserved. An empty reduced row is retained when the instance is infeasible; reduced row/column IDs permit independent reconstruction.
contract.scope: This is a matrix-presolve kernel only. It does not enumerate or select a set cover, test the almost-consecutive-ones property, or implement strong-C1P optimization.

workspace.meaning: Maximum caller-provided output capacity in bytes.

memory.meaning: Conservative bound for fixed row/column masks, activity flags, identity arrays, and staged output.

complexity.primary_time: O((m+n)*m*n^3) worst-case for m,n<=8 and at most m+n one-item reductions; each advanced candidate pair scans up to n columns for each of up to m exclusive rows
complexity.independent_optimum_check: O(2^n*m) by exhaustive enumeration of all column subsets before and after reduction

oracle_method: Primary uses row/column bit masks and fixed-point rules. The independent oracle uses row and column sets, then exhaustively compares exact minimum cover costs for the original and reduced matrices.
